_note: LEAN kit probe (bom.py LEAN). Copy to probe.json and replace every MEASURE value with the as-built probe. tau_int_s is written by 'python fit.py calibrate RUN.csv'.

disc.material: 99.6 % polished alumina 0.254 mm, cored Ø8 from a 25.4 mm substrate (bom.py LEAN)
disc._mass_note: MEASURE on a 0.1 mg balance; example = rho 3870 kg/m3 x pi 4^2 x 0.254 mm3
disc._d_note: MEASURE the cored diameter; contact_d_mm = measured d - 2 x chamfer leg (0.2 mm)

bond._note: post rim bonded to the disc (10 % of the disc) + 0.10 mm bondline (0.72 mJ/K), as cartridge_budget.py

element.part: IST P0K1.202 family Pt100, class F0.15 or better (same as the reference kit)
element._C_el_note: the Heraeus M222 class (~2.0 x 2.3 x 0.8 mm, C_el ~12.9 mJ/K) failed the self-test tolerance at h 888 (DECISIONS L3)

_tau_int_note: placeholder until the paste calibration is run
_sys_note: relative (absolute for tau_int_s) probe-constant uncertainties used for the verdict band; C_el drops to ~0.10 if 5 spare elements are weighed together (DECISIONS D6)
